# BookMyTM

> BookMyTM is an Indian legal-services platform for trademark registration, ISO certification, company and startup registration, intellectual property and statutory compliance.

BookMyTM ("Click. Start Business!") helps founders and businesses across India protect their brands and stay compliant, with a 100% digital process. Services span trademark search, filing and enforcement with IP India; patent and design registration; ISO certification; company, LLP and firm incorporation; and ongoing GST, PF, ESI and ROC compliance. The team operates from Kochi, Kerala with support for clients nationwide, and has filed over 10,000 trademarks for more than 15,000 users across 8+ years. Guides are published in English and Malayalam.
